people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Yahweh was angry with Solomon, because his heart was turned away from Yahweh, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice,
translations.bsb: Now the LORD grew angry with Solomon, because his heart had turned away from the LORD, the God of Israel, who had appeared to him twice.
